question: A 65-year-old woman presents with acute breathlessness. NT-proBNP returns at 1,800 pg/mL. Which interpretation is most accurate?

answers.text: NT-proBNP is normal; heart failure is excluded

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. The rule-out threshold for NT-proBNP in acute dyspnoea is <125 pg/mL (for non-acute setting) or <300 pg/mL (for acute setting). A value of 1,800 pg/mL is significantly elevated and does not exclude heart failure.

answers.text: NT-proBNP ≥900 pg/mL in a patient aged ≥75 years is the rule-in threshold; heart failure is confirmed

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Partially correct about the age-adjusted threshold (≥900 pg/mL for ≥75 years), but a single elevated NT-proBNP alone does not confirm heart failure — it must be interpreted with clinical findings and further investigation such as echocardiography.

answers.text: NT-proBNP 1,800 pg/mL is above the rule-in threshold (≥450 pg/mL for age <50, ≥900 for age 50–74, ≥1800 for age ≥75); heart failure is highly likely and warrants echocardiography

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Age-adjusted NT-proBNP rule-in thresholds are ≥450 pg/mL (<50 yr), ≥900 pg/mL (50–74 yr), ≥1800 pg/mL (≥75 yr). At 1,800 pg/mL this patient (age 65, so threshold 900) is clearly above the rule-in threshold; heart failure is highly likely and echocardiography is indicated to classify and quantify.

answers.text: NT-proBNP elevation confirms HFrEF; no echocardiogram is needed

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. NT-proBNP cannot distinguish HFrEF from HFmrEF or HFpEF; it only reflects myocardial wall stress. Echocardiography is essential to classify the phenotype and guide management.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review NT-proBNP interpretation: age-adjusted rule-in ≥450 (<50 yr), ≥900 (50–74 yr), ≥1800 (≥75 yr). An elevated NT-proBNP makes heart failure highly likely but echocardiography is required to classify.
Well done. Remember the age-adjusted NT-proBNP thresholds (<450 / 900 / 1800 pg/mL for <50 / 50–74 / ≥75 yr) and that elevated values prompt — not replace — echocardiography.
